decision: Publish a 21 s 'tonight' reminder for the Geminids, on the day of the peak night, after the weekly episode
rationale: The weekly episode explains the week and goes out earlier; this one is date-urgent and should land on 13 Dec. One number only (150/h) plus the single time that matters (moonset 20:04), so it does not repeat the weekly script. Radiant peaks at 01:52 at 73 deg in the south, which is the maximum altitude at 50N for dec +33.
alternatives: Skip the reminder and rely on the weekly (rejected: option 2 of the approved slate)
Make it a second 35 s weekly (rejected: cannibalises the weekly and misses the format's promise)
Publish on 14 Dec (rejected: the best night has already passed in Europe)
